title: feat(ui): undo a business-record delete from its toast through the recycle bin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPnyAMycuSU2XHXgpgorGJU)_
Part of #30239

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除一条业务对象记录后，“已删除”提示多了一个「撤销」按钮（控制台列表、插件列表、记录页三处）。撤销走回收站恢复接口 `POST {data}/:object/recycle-bin/:entryId/restore`，按原 id 恢复，不会重新创建记录；恢复被拒时按原因给出七句之一（唯一值被占、父记录已彻底删除、包已卸载、父记录也在回收站、条目不存在、无权限、本部署没有回收站）。业务对象的删除确认改成只问“确定要删除这条记录吗？”，不再说“此操作无法撤销”；平台对象（`sys_`、`cloud_`、`ai_`）保持原文。
- 为什么改：ADR-0148 之后业务对象删除会进回收站，但控制台既拿不到 `recycleBinEntryId`（适配器丢了它），确认框还在说“无法撤销”，这和服务端的实际行为不一致。
- 风险与回滚：撤销按钮只在同时满足两点时出现：服务端返回了条目 id，并且调用者在该对象上有 `allowRestoreOwnDeleted`（经 `objectPermissionGrants` 读取，`manageRecycleBin`、`modifyAllRecords` 也算）。缺任一项时提示与今天逐字相同；批量删除的提示不变。`DataSource` 只做加法（`delete` 仍返回 boolean）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts` 的 `successToast` 和 `undo`，再看 `core/src/actions/recycleBinRestore.ts`（拒绝码到语言包键的映射）和 `app-shell/src/utils/recycleBinRestore.ts`（权限判断）。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.deleteDialog-11695.test.tsx -t 30239`，预期 8 个用例全绿（en、zh 各四个：往返、拒绝原因、无权限对照、无条目对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。管理端回收站页面在第二个 PR（`Fixes #30239`），它复用本 PR 的拒绝原因映射。

## What changes

- **(A) `@object-ui/types` `DataSource`**, additive only: `delete(resource, id, opts?)` options gain `onRecycleBinEntry?: (entryId: string) => void`, and `DataSource` gains an optional `restoreRecycleBinEntry?(resource, entryId)`. `delete` still resolves to a boolean.
- **(A) `@object-ui/data-objectstack`**: `delete` calls `onRecycleBinEntry` with the server's `recycleBinEntryId`, after the delete's mutation event, only when the delete succeeded and the answer carries a non-empty id. `restoreRecycleBinEntry` is the SDK's `recycleBin.restore`. It emits no mutation event (the vocabulary has no restore, and a restore is never a create), and a refusal is normalised as every write's is, so a 409 `RESTORE_*` keeps its `code` and `details` and is not a `ConcurrentUpdateError`.
- **`@object-ui/core`**:
  - New `recycleBinRestoreRefusalText(t, error, labels)` with `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_KEYS`. It maps the door's seven codes (the spec's four `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_CODES` plus `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`) to one `recycleBin.refusal.*` sentence each, naming objects and fields by label with the machine name as fallback. An unknown code answers `undefined`, so the caller keeps its generic copy. The admin page in PR 2 reuses it.
  - `recordDelete`: the host passes an optional `restore` (and `refusalLabels`). With both an entry id and `restore`, the success toast carries an `actions.undo` action. Undo restores, refreshes, and toasts `restoredNamed` / `restoreSuccess`; a refusal toasts `restoreFailed` with the refusal sentence, or the server message for an unknown code. With neither, `toast.success(message)` is called with exactly one argument, as today. The entry id is asked for only when `restore` is present, so a host without it calls `delete(object, id)` exactly as before.
  - `recordDelete.entersRecycleBin(name)` is the engine's own predicate (`!hasPlatformObjectPrefix`). It picks the confirm copy: `objectActions.deleteConfirmQuestion` and `console.objectView.bulkDeleteQuestion` for a business object, today's keys for a platform object.
- **The hosts decide the grant; core reads no permission.**
  - `app-shell` `useObjectActions` (console list) and `RecordDetailView` (record page) build `restore` through the new `utils/recycleBinRestore.ts`. That util reads `usePermissions().effectiveObjects` as `MePermissionsProvider` does (lowercase key, the key as given, then `'*'`) and folds it with `objectPermissionGrants(…, 'allowRestoreOwnDeleted')`. On the record page, a successful Undo also navigates back to the record.
  - `plugin-view` `ObjectView` (the plugin list) does the same with a local reader, since it cannot import app-shell, and its fallback dictionary gains the new English keys.
  - `plugin-detail` `DetailView`: the confirm reads `detail.deleteConfirmQuestion` for a business object, per the amendment. Platform objects and a declared `schema.deleteConfirmation` are unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**, every pack: `objectActions.deleteConfirmQuestion`, `restoredNamed`, `restoreSuccess`, `restoreFailed`; `detail.deleteConfirmQuestion`; the `console.objectView.bulkDeleteQuestion` count family; and `recycleBin.refusal.{uniqueValueTaken, parentPurged, packageUninstalled, parentInRecycleBin, notFound, permissionDenied, notAvailable}`. zh-Hant is generated with `gen:zh-hant`. Each question is the platform sentence minus its permanence sentence.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30239-recycle-bin-undo-toast.md` (seven `@object-ui/*` packages, patch).

## Tests

New:

- `core/src/actions/__tests__/recycleBinRestore.test.ts`: the key map covers the spec's `RECYCLE_BIN_RESTORE_REFUSAL_CODES`; an `it.each` over the seven codes checks the exact key and placeholders; the field label falls back to the machine name; CONTROL: an unknown code and a codeless error answer `undefined`.
- `core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.test.ts`, new describe "recordDelete and the recycle bin": business vs platform confirm copy; a round trip where Undo restores once with `(object, entryId)`, never calls `create`, refreshes and names the record; a refusal toasts its sentence, not the server message; CONTROLs for an unknown code, no entry id, no `restore`, and a batch.
- `i18n/src/__tests__/recycle-bin-delete-copy-30239.test.ts`: in every pack, each question equals its platform sentence minus the permanence sentence, the seven refusal sentences are distinct, none equals the generic failure, and each carries en's placeholders; the restore toasts' placeholders; exact en and zh-Hans sentences.
- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.deleteDialog-11695.test.tsx`, new `describe.each` en/zh "console list Delete undo", through the real `MePermissionsProvider`: round trip; a refusal in the session language; CONTROL with no grant (`delete` called with two arguments and a one-argument toast); CONTROL with no entry id.
- `app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/recycleBinRestore-30239.test.ts`: the grant fold (`allowRestoreOwnDeleted`, `manageRecycleBin`, `'*'` `modifyAllRecords`, case), plus CONTROLs: no read, no row, permissions not loaded, no restore on the data source.
- `data-objectstack/src/recycleBinEntry-30239.test.ts`: the entry id is reported after the mutation event; no report without an id or for an unconfirmed delete; restore calls `recycleBin.restore` with no create and no event; a 409 refusal keeps `code` and `details`.

Edited pins. Each asserted the permanence sentence or key on a business object, which this card retires; nothing else in them changes and no assertion is removed:

- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.test.tsx`: `objectActions.deleteConfirm` → `objectActions.deleteConfirmQuestion`, and `console.objectView.bulkDeleteConfirm` → `console.objectView.bulkDeleteQuestion` (crm_product).
- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx`: `EN/ZH.objectActions.deleteConfirm` → `deleteConfirmQuestion`, and `bulkDeleteConfirm_other` → `bulkDeleteQuestion_other`, as the base the cascade line is appended to.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx`: `EN.objectActions.deleteConfirm` → `deleteConfirmQuestion`, the same base.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001.test.tsx`: the body is found by `deleteConfirmQuestion` (en and zh). The #27823 assertion "the body contains `This cannot be undone.`" becomes "the dialog does not contain it" for this business record (crm_call). The platform-object side is still pinned, unedited, in `i18n/src/__tests__/record-delete-permanent-27823.test.ts`.
- `plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.gridDelete-10383.test.tsx`: the two literal sentences lose ` This cannot be undone.`, and the docblock bullet says why.
- `core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.test.ts` (confirmCopy) and `recordDelete.cascade-28472.test.ts`: the business-object cases expect the Question keys.
- `i18n/src/__tests__/record-delete-permanent-27823.test.ts`: docblock only, saying the sentence is now the platform keys'.

## Acceptance notes

- Before the delete, the console cannot know whether the server will write a recycle-bin entry, so the confirm promises neither permanence nor recovery. The toast tells the truth afterwards.
- A batch delete keeps today's toast, as the amendment confirmed: each record writes its own entry, and one toast action would have to restore N entries, any of which can be refused on its own. The admin page in PR 2 is where several entries are restored.
- `member_default` holds neither `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` nor `manageRecycleBin`, so a default member sees no Undo until an admin grants it. The restore door would refuse them anyway, and the toast never offers an action the runtime refuses.
- Out of this PR: the admin recycle-bin page and its Setup nav item (PR 2), per-entry purge and "restore the parent first" (out of v1).

## Verification

Head `e6d5861b`. Branch cut from `c2bb879f`, with origin/main merged at `e253f3ab` (five incoming commits; none touches this diff's files, and no parallel fix was found).

- app-shell, plugin-view and plugin-detail delete files (`useObjectActions.deleteDialog-11695`, `useObjectActions`, `useObjectActions.deleteCascade-28472`, `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001`, `RecordDetailView.deleteCascade-28472`, `ObjectView.gridDelete-10383`, `DetailView`, `DetailView.permissions`): `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 78 passed (78)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor x1 -> x0, restored blob == HEAD 1283125320a4 and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

The undo attach line in `recordDelete.ts`, `if (!entryId || !restore) {`, replaced by `if (true) {`, so no toast ever carries Undo. `recordDelete.test.ts` with `useObjectActions.deleteDialog-11695.test.tsx`: `Tests 7 failed | 29 passed (36)`. The 7 are the core round trip, the refusal and unknown-code cases, and the app-shell round trip and refusal in en and zh. The no-grant and no-entry CONTROLs stay green, as they should. The core module is imported from `src`, so there is no dist leg.
</details>
